fields.description: 2 to 6 letters or digits. Numbers allowance vouchers (ALW-<code>-YY-#####). Changing it starts a new voucher series.
fields.label: Short Code

fields.description: Setup / presentation preset only (ADR-005). Does not fork pricing, availability, or channel sync.
fields.label: Property Kind

fields.description: Instant: guest books into Pending Payment or Confirmed. Request to Book: guest waits for host approval (Requested). ADR-006.
fields.label: Booking Mode

fields.description: Minutes a Held / Pending Payment reservation keeps inventory before auto-cancel.
fields.label: Hold Window (minutes)

fields.description: One-time cleaning fee added to every quote (ADR-008). 0 = none.
fields.label: Cleaning Fee

fields.description: When checked, cleaning fee is taxed at the room GST rate.
fields.label: Cleaning Fee Taxable
Room levy name
fields.description: A per-night levy charged on the room rate - municipality fee (Saudi Arabia, UAE), tourism or city tax. Leave the % at 0 when none applies.

fields.label: VAT / tax applies to the levy

fields.description: What a credit company pays when it has no billing rules of its own. Explicit rules always win; liquor never bills to a company.
fields.label: Default company billing
fields.options:
Room and F&B (liquor to guest)
Room only
Everything except liquor
Nothing (guest pays unless rules say so)

fields.description: Released to the guest only after payment, deposit, and optional pre-check-in gates pass.
fields.label: Access Instructions
Auto-send self check-in links to arrivals

fields.description: Slab: rate decides GST (India). Fixed: use the room type's tax_percent.
fields.label: Room GST Mode

fields.description: On: configured room prices are tax-inclusive; the engine back-computes the taxable value.
fields.label: Rates Include Tax
Modules In Use
fields.description: Which parts of Kamra this property actually runs, comma separated. Empty = everything. A serviced-apartment operator has no restaurant and no banquet hall, and shouldn't be shown three empty menus on their first morning.

fields.label: Booking Payment
fields.options:
Pay at hotel
Advance percent
Registration fee
Full online
fields.description: What the guest pays online when booking on the public page. Existing bookings keep the terms they were made under.

fields.label: Advance %
fields.description: Percent of the total collected upfront; the rest is paid at the hotel.

fields.label: Registration Fee
fields.description: Flat amount collected upfront; the rest is paid at the hotel.

fields.label: Require cashier PIN on money actions
Petty cash float
fields.description: Standing imprest for this property only. Each hotel keeps its own petty cash box and vouchers.

fields.label: Business Date
fields.description: Current front-office business date. Advanced by night audit.

fields.label: Hero Image
fields.description: 1920×1080px (16:9 landscape), JPG or WebP under 2 MB. The big photo at the top of the booking page.

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
1 Star
2 Star
3 Star
4 Star
5 Star
Boutique
Homestay

fields.description: Comma-separated, e.g. Pool, Parking, Restaurant
fields.label: Property Amenities (public)

fields.description: Square, 512×512px. PNG or SVG with a transparent background. Shown on the booking page and invoices.
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: Accent hex (e.g. #0f6b54) for the booking page - buttons, links, highlights.
fields.label: Booking Page Accent

fields.description: Verify & Discard (recommended, DPDP data minimisation) masks ID numbers to the last 4 digits and deletes ID photos at checkout. Store keeps them.
fields.label: ID Retention
Erase guest data after (months)
fields.description: Guests with no stay for this long are erased automatically (bills stay for the books). 0 keeps them indefinitely. Blacklisted guests are kept.

fields.label: Clear message text after (days)
fields.description: WhatsApp message text and AI assistant chats older than this are cleared every night. Who, when and delivery status stay for audit. 0 keeps them.

fields.label: Privacy contact (Grievance Officer)
fields.description: Email or phone that guests can use for access, correction and erasure requests. Shown on the booking and check-in pages.
Shown to staff in the booking dialog and read by the AI agent as its upsell prompt.
fields.label: Sell Message

fields.description: Cancellations at least this many days before arrival are free.
fields.label: Free Cancellation (days before arrival)
Cancellation Tiers
fields.description: Leave empty to use the single free-cancellation window above. Add bands for a tiered policy, e.g. 7 days / 0%, 3 days / 50%, 0 days / 100%.

When an arrival that never checked in becomes a No Show. At audit for arrival date: the night audit that closes the arrival date marks it. One day later: it stays Due In until the audit of the following day.
fields.label: No-show Timing
fields.options:
At audit for arrival date
One day later

fields.description: When on, an arrival due on the date being closed is held as Due In, not marked a No Show, if it is flagged Late Arrival, or its ETA (property local time; times before 06:00 mean after midnight) is later than the moment the audit runs. A held arrival is marked a No Show at the next audit if it still has not checked in.
fields.label: Protect Late Arrivals

fields.description: Skip the no-show fee for bookings from an OTA or channel (source OTA, a channel or an OTA reference), because the OTA collects under its own policy. The reservation is still marked No Show.
fields.label: Waive No-show Fee for OTA Bookings

fields.description: Blank = off. At this local time, today's arrivals that are not guaranteed are cancelled with no fee and the room is released. Guaranteed means: an advance paid, a payment or deposit on the folio, an OTA or channel booking, or a company (corporate) booking. Bookings made after the release time and stays flagged Late Arrival are left alone.
fields.label: Release Non-guaranteed Arrivals At

fields.description: Advance expected at booking, as % of the stay total.
fields.label: Deposit %

fields.description: Lets guests and the desk add pets to a booking. Unchecked, a booking with pets is refused.
fields.label: Pets Allowed

fields.description: Charge per pet, added to the quote as its own line. 0 = pets stay free.
fields.label: Pet Charge
Booking Engine Language
fields.description: Language guests see first on the booking engine and self check-in. Empty: the guest's browser language. Guests can still switch.

fields.label: OG Image
fields.description: Exactly 1200×630px, JPG or PNG. What WhatsApp, Google and social previews show when the booking page is shared.

fields.label: Overbooking Allowance %
fields.description: Sell unassigned bookings above physical capacity by this much (0 = never overbook). Room types can override.

fields.label: Setup Wishlist
fields.description: What was asked for during setup (e.g. channel-manager), so the Finish setup list can remind.
Let staff with MCP Read or MCP Manage connect Claude or another MCP client to this property. The site setting kamra_mcp_disabled still turns MCP off everywhere.
fields.label: AI access over MCP

fields.description: AI clients can look but never change anything at this property, whatever the person's MCP role.
fields.label: Block write tools

fields.description: Tool names AI clients may not use at this property, as a JSON list. Managed under Settings, AI access (MCP).
fields.label: Blocked MCP tools
